hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Swellable packer (openhole systems)
function: The elastomer element on the casing between sleeves in an openhole system that swells against the bare hole to isolate one stage from the next.

tabs.overview: Swells in oil or water over days after the string is run; mechanical set packers are the alternative. Cemented sleeve systems use cement instead.
tabs.engineering: Per API 11D1 where validated; swell time and differential rating per the design.
tabs.safety: Isolation depends on the swell being complete before the first stage.
tabs.evidence: Completion codes article (S34), ball injector patent (S35), API 11D1 for packers (S21), field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
